observationsNotFailures: consumeUpdateClass (docs/roomstate.go) finds a recorded class by comparing update bytes and takes the first match. Two commits can carry byte-identical updates - two peers deleting one range encode the same delete set and no new struct - and their classes are then interchangeable. The storm reproduced it until the harness stopped re-sending such an update. It is main's code, untouched by this pull request, and the two classes are of the same change, so nothing a reader sees differs; recorded so the next round does not rediscover it as a defect of this change.
